contacts: all unknown for the baseline model comparison
model_selection: predicted ranking score across samples; report oracle separately
failure_policy: all official category denominators retained; resource/input/scoring failures explicit

parallelism.assignment: deterministic greedy balancing by token count squared; exact same target partitions for both model weights

evaluation_inputs: full sequence/CCD and independently prepared MSAs; no cropping or native pocket
search_decision: Use validation matched-time results to decide whether any adaptive method warrants a separate blind comparison; retain ordinary sampling when search does not improve validation selection quality.
alignment_completion_policy: Freeze initial ready inputs while 13 assemblies await the original MMseqs2 job; evaluate deferred inputs under a second immutable HF revision with identical model settings, then combine disjoint predictions. All 1522 assemblies remain in denominators.
